key_parts.question: In the Kaggle Bank Customer Churn dataset (10,000 customers in France, Germany and Spain), what is the churn rate of customers in Germany compared with France and Spain?

answer.question: In the Kaggle Bank Customer Churn dataset (10,000 customers in France, Germany and Spain), what is the churn rate of customers in Germany compared with France and Spain?
answer.answer: Based on the provided data, the overall churn rate for Germany is 32.4% (with 2,509 customers and 814 churned), whereas France has a churn rate of 16.2% (with 5,014 customers and 811 churned) and Spain has a churn rate of 16.7% (with 2,477 customers and 413 churned) [kaggle_summary_geography].

chunks.text:
# Churn rate by Geography x active member

Source: Kaggle "Bank Customer Churn" dataset (customers of a bank in France, Germany and Spain). Overall churn rate: 20.4%.

| Segment | Customers | Churned | Churn rate | Mean balance | Mean points |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| France / 0 | 2,423 | 513 | 21.2% | 63,463.58 | 609.5 |
| France / 1 | 2,591 | 298 | 11.5% | 60,810.59 | 605.0 |
| Germany / 0 | 1,261 | 518 | 41.1% | 119,587.11 | 609.5 |
| Germany / 1 | 1,248 | 296 | 23.7% | 119,874.61 | 611.0 |
| Spain / 0 | 1,165 | 272 | 23.3% | 59,616.31 | 602.0 |
| Spain / 1 | 1,312 | 141 | 10.7% | 63,773.29 | 600.9 |

In plain language: by geography x active member, the highest churn rate is 41.1% (Germany / 0) and the lowest is 10.7% (Spain / 1).
